transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
Um… I guess I’m here because of my eating. At night, when I’m alone, once I start, it kind of feels like something takes over. I’ll be telling myself to stop and put the food away, but I just… don’t.
Can you describe what it feels like when you're eating and you're trying to stop? Do you feel like you can't control it once you start?
Yeah… once I start, especially at night when I’m alone, it feels like I don’t really have control of it. I’ll be thinking, like, “put it away, stop,” but I just keep going.
Do you find yourself eating large amounts of food in a short period, especially when you’re alone, and feel like you can’t stop once you start?

Yeah… especially after late shifts. I’ll be alone and it’ll be, like, a frozen pizza, then cereal out of the box, leftovers… snacks from the cabinet. It can all happen in an hour or two. I wouldn’t eat like that around anyone else.
After these episodes of eating, do you ever make yourself vomit, use laxatives, or do anything else to try to compensate for the food you ate?
Yeah… I do. I usually go to the bathroom after and make myself throw up. It feels like… like I have to undo it before it really counts.
How often do you find yourself making yourself vomit after eating like this — is it every time, most times, or only occasionally?
Most times, I guess. Not every single time, but… for the last few months, usually at least one night a week it happens — I eat too much when I’m by myself, and then I make myself throw up after.
Do you make yourself throw up mainly because you feel like you’ve eaten too much and you’re worried about gaining weight or how your body looks?
Yeah… mostly. After I eat like that, I just feel like I need to get rid of it. Like if I throw up, maybe I can undo it before the calories… I don’t know, settle in.
When you make yourself throw up, is it mainly because you feel physically uncomfortable from eating too much, or is it more about feeling like you’ve lost control during the eating?

It’s more the control thing, I think. Like… once I’m eating alone at night, it feels like something kind of takes over, and even while I’m telling myself to stop, I just don’t. Then afterward I feel like I have to do something about it.
